hotel.title: The Hotel
hotel.description: Hidden among the lanes of the historic centre of Pula, a true surprise — a small Boutique Hotel waiting to be discovered in every detail

ristorante.title: The Restaurant
ristorante.description: Mediterranean cuisine, from handmade pasta passed down through generations to garden-fresh produce. Passion and love for the land inspire our dishes every day

chia.title: The Sea
chia.description: White sandy beaches and crystal-clear waters just minutes from the hotel. From Nora to Chia, one of the most beautiful coastlines in the Mediterranean

mare.title: Sardinia
mare.description: An ancient and untamed island, where nature has never ceased to amaze. Every corner tells a story waiting to be discovered

gutturu.title: Gutturu Mannu
gutturu.description: The largest forest in the Mediterranean, just minutes from Pula — a sanctuary for the Sardinian deer and a treasure of unspoilt nature

santEfisio.label: May 2025
santEfisio.testo: From May 1st to 4th, Sardinia's most important and colourful procession departs from Cagliari — and arrives in Pula. Experience it from your room at Villa Madau Boutique Hotel.
santEfisio.cta: Discover the rooms with a view

autunno.label: Autumn 2025
autunno.testo: The last stretch of summer — pleasant temperatures, warm sea, breathtaking sunsets and empty beaches.

primavera.label: Low season
primavera.testo: April and May are the most beautiful months: the scent of Mediterranean scrub, deserted beaches, mild temperatures. Villa Madau is open and the village awaits you.

pasqua.label: Easter 2026
pasqua.testo: Sea and mountains, breakfast in the garden, trails through Gutturu Mannu park and Mediterranean cuisine. The most wonderful Easter weekend ever, in the historic heart of Pula.

ristorante.label: Our restaurant
ristorante.title: The authentic flavours of Sardinia
ristorante.paragrafo1: The Villa Madau restaurant is a journey through Sardinian culinary tradition. Every dish is prepared with local, seasonal ingredients, selected from the finest producers of the Sulcis area and southern Sardinia.
ristorante.paragrafo2: From malloreddus alla campidanese to exquisite Cabras bottarga, from freshly grilled fish from the Gulf of Cagliari to traditional desserts such as seadas with corbezzolo honey: every meal is an unforgettable experience.

lista.cucina: Cuisine based on local, seasonal produce
lista.vini: Selection of DOC and DOCG Sardinian wines

ristorante.imageAlt: Villa Madau Restaurant Pula - traditional Sardinian cuisine

location.label: Where we are
location.title: The heart of southern Sardinia
location.paragrafo: Villa Madau is located in the historic centre of Pula, a medieval village in southern Sardinia steeped in history and traditions. Its privileged position allows you to explore the old town on foot and easily reach the wonders of the surrounding area.
location.imageAlt: Southern Sardinia - Chia beaches near Pula

ctaFinale.label: Book your stay
ctaFinale.title: Experience Sardinia from Villa Madau
ctaFinale.paragrafo: Contact us for availability and rates. We will reply within 24 hours.
